main.description: Get private-tier posts by AT-URI. Requires auth by a ready community member. A URI that does not exist, is not authorized for the requester, or cannot be served is omitted from the response; other URIs are unaffected. Audiences this AppView resolves: `list` (the audience record's members); `followers` (followers of the audience's owner who are ready members of this AppView, by the follow records it has indexed, which reflect a new follow or an unfollow within about a minute); `everyone` (every ready member of this AppView, not the network); and `nobody`. `following`: the accounts the audience's owner follows that are ready members of this AppView, by the follow records it has indexed, once it has compared them with the owner's repository. Until then, and always for an owner that follows more than 50 000 accounts, a `following` audience is read by its owner alone, and replies under it by their authors alone. An unfollow stops reads within about a minute. A `following` post appears in a reader's timeline only when the reader also follows its owner. When neither the owner nor a replier is a ready member, and this AppView is not indexing public records, the owner's follow of the replier is not indexed, so that reply is read by its author alone. Any other mode is served to its author only. A block record between the reader and the author, or the audience's owner, in either direction, keeps the reader out, and so does a block through a list where 'private.listBlocks' is listed. A reply is read by the readers of its thread root's current audience, or, in a private branch under a public post, of its branch root's current audience. It is served only when all of these hold: its root (or branch root) is stored, names an audience of its own author, and is visible; the reply names an audience of that author; its author, and the author of every post above it in its chain other than the root's author, may write under the root's current audience now, by the PDS's rule for that mode, and there is no block either way between them and the root's author; its chain of parents, through stored private posts agreeing on its root, reaches a post by the root's author (or the branch root) within 16 posts (this AppView's `max_chain`), each visible to the reader. The root author's own replies in a thread are not walked, and are read by the root's audience whatever audience they name. Replies deeper than the bound, or below someone who no longer stands under the current audience, are read only by their authors, except the root author's own thread replies. A post is never served to a reader where either has blocked the other. Its author always reads it, unless moderation hides it, even when the thread's owner has blocked the author or removed them from the audience. `audience` on the view is the governing audience.

degraded.description: Present and true while this AppView is degraded: a relay it reads private posts from is behind, so posts may be missing for now and should not be shown as deleted. Absent otherwise. The same for every requester at a given moment.

retryAfter.description: With degraded: seconds to wait before asking again (also sent as the Retry-After header).

unavailable.description: The requester's own private posts this response read and could not serve yet, each once; absent when none. Never names another account's post.

errors.name: NotEnrolled
errors.description: The caller is not a community member of this AppView.

errors.name: NotReady
errors.description: The caller's account indexing is still in progress.

errors.name: Reindexing
errors.description: The caller's account is being re-indexed after an interruption; retry after `retryAfter` seconds (in the body; also the Retry-After header). Not NotReady: the caller is still a member.
